en: The Two Internal Triads and the Root-Duad.
Dependent on an internal, non-causal state, an external causal state arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on an external, non-causal state, an internal causal state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. There are two [instances] for the root condition...
pe ... and two for the non-disappearance condition.
Dependent on a state with internal object that is not a root, there arises a state with internal object that is a root, by way of root condition... two.
Dependent on a state with external object that is not a root, there arises a state with external object that is a root, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root: six; under object: six; under predominance: two... pe ... under prenascence and repetition: two... pe ... under non-disappearance: six.
